n18ee68a5bc.headline: HDFC Bank addresses report on MD & CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan extension - BusinessToday
n18ee68a5bc.summary: HDFC Bank has addressed a report concerning the extension of MD and CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan, who joined the bank in 1996 and has spent 27 years there.
n18ee68a5bc.why: HDFC Bank is one of India's largest private-sector lenders, so leadership continuity is closely watched by investors.

n42c73180cc.headline: Rs 12 lakh crore shock! Sensex, Nifty wipe out 3 day gains on fag end selling; what’s ahead? - BusinessToday
n42c73180cc.summary: Sensex and Nifty wiped out three days of gains in late-session selling. Combined market capitalisation of BSE-listed companies fell to Rs 426 lakh crore from Rs 438 lakh crore.
n42c73180cc.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the main benchmark indices of Indian equity markets, so their moves reflect broad investor sentiment toward Indian stocks.
n42c73180cc.why_moved: Selling in the final part of the session wiped out three days of gains. The combined market value of BSE-listed companies fell by about Rs 12 lakh crore.

n3cc9b7fd9d.headline: Ukraine starts building gas reserves for winter as Russian strikes hurt output, data shows
n3cc9b7fd9d.summary: Ukraine has begun storing gas in underground facilities for the coming heating season. It is boosting imports after Russia damaged its gas production infrastructure.
n3cc9b7fd9d.why: Gas storage levels determine how much supply a country has for winter heating, and they influence European gas prices when imports rise.

n81d91a297f.headline: Ministry of Finance listed Fidelis government bonds worth nearly 1.2B lei on Bucharest Stock Exchange
n81d91a297f.summary: The Finance Ministry raised almost 1.2 billion lei, equal to 231 million euros, through its third Fidelis bond issue of the year in March. The bonds began trading on the Bucharest Stock Exchange.
n81d91a297f.why: Government bond issuance funds public spending and sets sovereign borrowing costs, which benchmark local debt markets.

n1225a49ca6.headline: It's called 'private credit' — and it could lead to big trouble on Wall Street
n1225a49ca6.summary: Private credit, a risky lending business that has been booming, is showing increasing problems on Wall Street and beyond, according to the report.
n1225a49ca6.why: Private credit funds lend directly to companies outside the traditional bank system, and their losses can reach banks, insurers and pension investors.

n482896c155.headline: Marlborough winegrowers brace for challenging years ahead
n482896c155.summary: New Zealand's largest wine region faces a prolonged downturn, with growers cutting production and facing mounting financial pressure. Industry leaders say the road back to profitability will be slow.
n482896c155.why: Marlborough is New Zealand's dominant wine region and a major exporter, so its grower economics shape the country's wine exports.

n467dd66da2.headline: Macroeconomic Confidence Indicator rises in February amid expectations on budget deficit reduction
n467dd66da2.summary: The CFA Romania Association's Macroeconomic Confidence Indicator rose slightly in February 2026 to 48.4 points, reflecting improved analyst expectations on economic developments and budget deficit reduction.
n467dd66da2.why: Investor and analyst sentiment on the macro outlook informs expectations for Romanian assets, including bonds and the leu. Fiscal consolidation is a key factor for sovereign risk.

n7abfa16c90.headline: Vukile strengthens Spanish retail hold with key acquisition
n7abfa16c90.summary: Vukile's Castellana Properties is acquiring 50% of the Splau Centre in Barcelona. The deal strengthens its Iberian retail portfolio, according to the company's stated strategy of growth-focused shopping assets.
n7abfa16c90.why: Vukile is a South African listed property fund that owns retail real estate, largely in South Africa and Spain. Acquisitions like this shape its rental income and portfolio exposure.

n3d17e4d271.headline: The Pentagon wants an extra $200 billion for the Iran war and beyond
n3d17e4d271.summary: The Trump administration is seeking a large budget to refill and expand its munitions stockpiles. The request is tied to the Iran war and beyond, according to the source.
n3d17e4d271.why: Defense spending requests shape budgets for major contractors and the federal fiscal outlook.

nb80c2e488a.headline: German defence minister stresses need to shore up supply chains
nb80c2e488a.summary: German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius identified weaknesses in Germany's supply chains and the security of supply for defence companies. He called for backup plans to be developed.
nb80c2e488a.why: Defence procurement and industrial supply chains affect the revenues of arms makers and the broader German industrial base.

naf91ace4f8.headline: Service stations emerge as valuable assets in surprise electric vehicle property boom
naf91ace4f8.summary: With petrol nearing $3 a litre, service stations have become assets worth nearly $900 million as investors bet on their electric future.
naf91ace4f8.why: Service stations are real estate and fuel retail sites, and their value depends on fuel demand and whether they can convert to electric vehicle charging.

n01ed005b4a.headline: EU urges pause in strikes on energy, water facilities
n01ed005b4a.summary: European leaders are calling for a moratorium on military strikes targeting energy and water facilities in the Middle East.
n01ed005b4a.why: Attacks on energy infrastructure can disrupt oil and gas supply and raise regional risk premiums across global commodity markets.

n86747477d7.headline: Iran war: Power outage reported in Israel
n86747477d7.summary: The conflict involving the US, Israel and Iran has entered its 20th day with hostilities intensifying. Iran is targeting oil facilities in Gulf nations after an attack on its gas fields, and a power outage was reported in Israel.
n86747477d7.why: Attacks on oil and gas infrastructure in the Gulf can disrupt global crude and LNG supply, which moves energy prices and inflation expectations.
n86747477d7.why_moved: Iran is reported to be targeting Gulf oil facilities after an attack on its gas fields, raising concern about supply disruption.

nb72e802574.headline: Why Trump's attacks and threats to Iran's Kharg Island are a big deal
nb72e802574.summary: The US has struck Kharg Island a second time, hitting military targets. A US strike on the island's oil infrastructure would be a serious blow to an already struggling global oil market.
nb72e802574.why: Kharg Island is Iran's main crude export terminal, so any disruption there directly affects global oil supply.
nb72e802574.why_moved: The US has struck military targets on Kharg Island a second time, and the input notes that any hit on oil infrastructure would deepen strain on an already struggling oil market.

nfc89273dd2.headline: UniCredit:  Moody's affirms ratings following Commerzbank bid
nfc89273dd2.summary: Moody's has affirmed UniCredit's senior preferred and long-term deposit ratings at A3, two notches above Italy's sovereign rating, following the Commerzbank bid.
nfc89273dd2.why: UniCredit is a major Italian bank, and its ratings affect its funding costs; Commerzbank is a large German lender.

impacts.name: UniCredit
impacts.why: Moody's affirmation maintains UniCredit's credit ratings during its bid for Commerzbank.

n2814b5d3c0.headline: Fed Keeps Rates Steady as Powell Warns Iran Oil Shock Could Boost Inflation in 2026
n2814b5d3c0.summary: The Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged while Chair Jerome Powell warned that the rise in Iran-related oil prices could boost inflation in 2026. Investors are weighing prolonged high borrowing costs.
n2814b5d3c0.why: The Federal Reserve sets US benchmark interest rates, which shape borrowing costs, bond yields and equity valuations worldwide. Oil prices feed directly into inflation and therefore into rate expectations.
n2814b5d3c0.why_moved: The Fed held rates steady while flagging that higher oil prices from the Iran conflict could push inflation up, keeping borrowing costs elevated for longer.

nf7bac469f2.headline: RBNZ to expand communication, adding briefings after every policy decision.
nf7bac469f2.summary: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand will expand its communication by adding briefings after every policy decision. The move is expected to heighten market sensitivity around decisions while reducing uncertainty.
nf7bac469f2.why: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand sets the official cash rate, which drives New Zealand dollar, bond yields and mortgage pricing.

n8f0917b7c5.headline: Delivery riders race for Eid, but Mideast tensions squeezes earnings
n8f0917b7c5.summary: Delivery riders in Karachi are working hard ahead of Eid ul Fitr, but Middle East tensions are squeezing their earnings. The report focuses on gig workers in the city.
n8f0917b7c5.why: Fuel costs and consumer demand drive earnings for gig-economy delivery workers, and fuel prices are sensitive to Middle East conflict.

nbc79f3d390.headline: Kao’s Bioré Accelerates Global Growth with Entry into the South Korean Market and the Launch of a Unified Global Campaign
nbc79f3d390.summary: Kao's skincare brand Biore will accelerate its international expansion by entering the South Korean market. The company is also launching a unified global campaign.
nbc79f3d390.why: Kao is a Japanese consumer goods group, and its beauty and skincare brands are a source of overseas growth.

nfd164202f4.headline: NZ GDP disappoints at 0.2% as momentum fades into year-end
nfd164202f4.summary: New Zealand's economy grew 0.2% quarter on quarter in Q4, missing expectations of 0.4% and slowing from Q3's 0.9%. Annual growth was also 0.2%.
nfd164202f4.why: GDP growth is the broadest measure of economic output, and weak prints shape expectations for central-bank rate decisions and the local currency.

n32e4177a4a.headline: Iran War, selloff hit IPO frenzy: Half of 2026 issues fail to get full retail subscription - BusinessToday
n32e4177a4a.summary: Fourteen companies have listed in India so far in 2026, raising nearly Rs 15,000 crore. Returns have been negligible, and half the issues failed to get full retail subscription.
n32e4177a4a.why: IPO demand reflects investor risk appetite and the health of India's primary equity market.

n463e44929b.headline: Gold prices drops below Rs500,000 in Pakistan amid global uncertainty
n463e44929b.summary: Gold prices fell sharply in Pakistan on Thursday, following a downward trend in international markets. Local prices dropped below Rs500,000.
n463e44929b.why: Gold is a traditional store of value, and its price moves reflect global uncertainty and currency conditions.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: The local price follows the downward trend in international gold prices.

nebf9846e2a.headline: China Tries to Hold Off on Oil Reserves 'for as Long as It Can'
nebf9846e2a.summary: China is trying to hold off on tapping its oil reserves for as long as it can. The Mideast conflict is dragging on, and the country may have no choice but to draw on its supply.
nebf9846e2a.why: China is the world's largest crude oil importer, and its strategic reserves can be released to cushion supply shocks.

n697fbdd419.headline: Global fuel prices spike after Iran hits multiple Gulf oil and gas sites
n697fbdd419.summary: Iran launched missile and drone attacks on Gulf Arab energy sites, hitting refineries in Saudi Arabia and Kuwait and a Qatari LNG plant. The attacks sparked major fires and sent Brent crude to $118.
n697fbdd419.why: Brent crude is the main global benchmark for oil prices, and Gulf refineries and LNG plants supply a large share of world energy.
n697fbdd419.why_moved: Attacks on Saudi and Kuwaiti refineries and a Qatari LNG plant cut into Gulf energy supply, pushing Brent crude to $118 and fuel prices higher.

n49297c1ef7.headline: Gas prices soar as Shell plant damaged in attack on Qatar energy site
n49297c1ef7.summary: Shell said an attack on a Qatar energy site caused damage to a facility important to the firm. Gas prices have soared following the attack.
n49297c1ef7.why: Shell is a major global oil and gas company with large liquefied natural gas operations in Qatar.

n83c03eae7d.headline: Iran hits back at multiple Gulf refineries after Israeli strike on its offshore gas field
n83c03eae7d.summary: Iran intensified attacks on Gulf Arab neighbours' energy sites, hitting a Saudi refinery on the Red Sea after an Israeli strike on its offshore gas field.
n83c03eae7d.why: Refineries convert crude into fuels, and attacks on Gulf energy sites can cut refined product supply to global markets.
n83c03eae7d.why_moved: Attacks on refining capacity reduce supply of refined products, pushing up fuel prices and inflation concerns.

n45f5f74320.headline: Britain's 'summer of hell' if Iran war continues – from bread riots to car ban
n45f5f74320.summary: With the Strait of Hormuz blocked amid the US-Israel-Iran conflict, Britain faces surging energy prices, fuel rationing, and warnings of blackouts and economic turmoil.
n45f5f74320.why: Britain imports a significant share of its energy, so global supply shocks feed directly into domestic energy prices, inflation and household costs.

n1c9b678a3a.headline: Govt may leave fuel prices unchanged despite global oil spike
n1c9b678a3a.summary: Pakistan's government is weighing whether to keep petrol and high-speed diesel prices unchanged until March 31, while telling oil firms to avoid hoarding and seeking extra crude cargoes.
n1c9b678a3a.why: Pakistan imports most of its crude and refined fuel, so government pricing decisions affect fiscal costs and inflation.

n94d0397ba2.headline: Malaysia sees below-forecast rise in February CPI, exports
n94d0397ba2.summary: Malaysia's consumer price index rose by less than forecast in February, and exports also grew below expectations. The January CPI rise was 1.6%.
n94d0397ba2.why: Consumer price inflation and export growth are key indicators of Malaysia's economic health and central bank policy outlook.

nde018d7f23.headline: Israel hits Tehran with airstrikes on Persian New Year as war jolts energy markets
nde018d7f23.summary: Israel carried out airstrikes on Tehran on Friday as Iranians marked Nowruz, amid a war that has sent shock waves through the global economy.
nde018d7f23.why: Tehran is Iran's capital and a centre of its government. Strikes on Iran affect global oil supply expectations, which move energy prices and inflation outlooks.
nde018d7f23.why_moved: The article links the strikes to a war that has disrupted energy markets, which raises the risk of supply shortfalls and higher oil prices.

n328e740689.headline: Iran War: Asian shares fall as oil tops USD 111 barrel, Wall Street slumps
n328e740689.summary: Shares retreated in Asia after Wall Street slumped as oil prices spiked above $110 a barrel due to the ongoing US-Iran war.
n328e740689.why: Wall Street's major indexes set the tone for global equity markets. Oil above $110 raises inflation and growth concerns for importers and consumers.
n328e740689.why_moved: Oil prices spiked above $110 a barrel because of the ongoing US-Iran war, weighing on Asian and US stocks.

nb9296ee027.headline: Brent crude briefly tops $119 per barrel, before receding, and shakes stock markets worldwide
nb9296ee027.summary: Oil prices jumped to market-shaking levels above $119 a barrel before easing back late in the day, helping Wall Street pare its losses.
nb9296ee027.why: Brent is the main international crude benchmark, used to price much of the world's oil. Sharp moves in Brent feed into inflation expectations and equity market risk.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Brent briefly surged above $119 before retreating during the session.

nb9296ee027.why_moved: Oil briefly spiked above $119 a barrel amid the Middle East war, shaking markets before prices receded late in the session.

ndbed140239.headline: Malaysia's inflation up 1.4% in Feb 2026 - DOSM
ndbed140239.summary: Malaysia's inflation rose modestly to 1.4% in February 2026, with the consumer price index at 136.0 against 134.1 a year earlier, according to DOSM.
ndbed140239.why: Consumer price inflation shapes central bank policy and the ringgit's outlook. Investors track it as a gauge of domestic price pressure.

nf330ef58c8.headline: BoJ holds rates, signals further hikes despite temporary inflation dip
nf330ef58c8.summary: The Bank of Japan held its policy rate at 0.75% and signalled further hikes, looking through a temporary inflation dip as wage growth and rising oil prices support its outlook.
nf330ef58c8.why: The Bank of Japan sets Japan's policy rate, which drives yen movements and global carry-trade flows.
nf330ef58c8.why_moved: Signalling further hikes while looking through a temporary inflation dip shifts expectations for Japanese policy rates.

na0e44cdee9.headline: China set to keep rates steady as Mideast war clouds inflation outlook
na0e44cdee9.summary: China is poised to hold its key lending rates unchanged for the tenth straight month. The decision comes as global oil prices surge on Middle East tensions, clouding the inflation outlook.
na0e44cdee9.why: China's benchmark lending rates set the cost of credit in the world's second-largest economy and influence global commodity demand and yuan assets.

nb7f3746a6e.headline: Most Asian currencies decline; Philippine peso falls most
nb7f3746a6e.summary: Most Asian currencies weakened against the US dollar in early trade, with the Philippine peso falling the most. The table shows rates at 0203 GMT.
nb7f3746a6e.why: Asian currencies move with regional capital flows, dollar strength and commodity import costs, which affect trade and corporate earnings across the region.

impacts.name: Philippine peso
impacts.why: The peso fell more than other Asian currencies against the dollar.

n46f507127d.headline: Newly minted Thai Prime Minister Anutin has energy crisis on his hands
n46f507127d.summary: Newly elected Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul faces an immediate energy crisis as oil prices rise and the economy faces further challenges.
n46f507127d.why: Thailand is a major Southeast Asian economy, and its energy import costs and fuel subsidies feed directly into inflation, the baht and fiscal policy.

nad6c46eda0.headline: China's Alibaba targets $100B in AI and cloud revenue over 5 years
nad6c46eda0.summary: Alibaba Group pledged on Thursday a goal of surpassing $100 billion in revenue from its artificial intelligence and cloud businesses over the next five years, citing AI demand.
nad6c46eda0.why: Alibaba is China's largest e-commerce and cloud group, and its cloud and AI revenue targets signal how Chinese tech giants are positioning in the AI infrastructure race.

impacts.name: Alibaba Group
impacts.why: A multi-year revenue target for AI and cloud businesses sets an explicit growth goal for Alibaba's cloud segment.
